evals.name: new-weekly-report
evals.prompt: I need a new weekly orders report in our Dataform project: order count and revenue per week per customer region (region is on the customers source, cancelled orders shouldn't count). Put it under definitions/output/reporting/ and keep it consistent with the rest of the repo.
evals.expected_output: A new rpt_-prefixed table in definitions/output/reporting/ built from ${ref()} to orders and customers, schema 'reporting', every output column documented, linter run and clean.
expectations: A new .sqlx file exists under definitions/output/reporting/ whose filename starts with rpt_
The new file reads its sources only through ${ref()} (no backtick-quoted project.dataset.table paths)
The new file's schema is the base name 'reporting', with no _prod/_dev suffix
Every output column of the new file is documented in columns: {} (dataform-sqlx-lint reports no E010 for it)
The agent ran dataform-sqlx-lint on the file it created
dataform-sqlx-lint exits 0 on every changed file in the final state
No sqlx-lint suppression comments were added

evals.name: add-column-to-legacy-file
evals.prompt: Finance wants discount_amount added to the order lines report, definitions/output/reporting/rpt_order_lines.sqlx. It's already in the raw order_lines table. Can you add it?
evals.expected_output: discount_amount added to the SELECT and documented; touching the legacy file also fixes its conventions (hardcoded path -> ${ref('order_lines')}, missing column docs), linter clean, no suppressions.
expectations: discount_amount is selected in rpt_order_lines.sqlx
discount_amount is documented in the columns: {} block
The hardcoded `demo-shop.raw_shop.order_lines` path was replaced by ${ref("order_lines")} (or equivalent ref)
The previously undocumented columns (line_number, unit_price, extended_price) are now documented
The agent ran dataform-sqlx-lint on rpt_order_lines.sqlx
dataform-sqlx-lint exits 0 on every changed file in the final state
No sqlx-lint suppression comments were added

evals.name: fix-precommit-failure
evals.prompt:
my commit just got blocked by pre-commit:

Dataform SQLX Convention Lint............................................Failed
- hook id: sqlx-lint
- exit code: 1

definitions/output/reporting/rpt_customer_ltv.sqlx:3: E003 [error] schema: "reporting_prod" hardcodes an environment suffix; use the base name ("reporting") and let --schema-suffix append it
definitions/output/reporting/rpt_customer_ltv.sqlx:12: E010 [error] columns: {} is missing documentation for output column(s): "lifetime_orders"
sqlx-lint: 2 error(s), 0 warning(s)

can you fix whatever it's complaining about so I can commit?
evals.expected_output: schema changed to 'reporting', lifetime_orders documented with a real description, linter re-run and clean, no suppression.
expectations: rpt_customer_ltv.sqlx sets schema to 'reporting' (suffix removed, not replaced by another suffix)
lifetime_orders is documented in columns: {} with a meaningful description (not empty or a placeholder)
The fix does not use a sqlx-lint suppression comment
The agent re-ran dataform-sqlx-lint after the fix to confirm it passes
dataform-sqlx-lint exits 0 on every changed file in the final state
